name: NO_PARKING_LEFT_WHITE_TALL

sa_r5-sa40_no_parking_140.desc: no-parking roundel 140 dia: red annulus, black P 95 E (30/80/30 inside the ring), red slash from upper right to lower left — traced from R5-SA40L at 800 dpi (red and black layers)

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA40L 225 x 300 (2026, 1:5), R25, white, no border. No-parking roundel 140 dia, 60 from the top, centred (P 95 E: 30 / 80 / 30 inside the ring); 55 gap; black arrow 32 high, 13 from the bottom (y 255-287). Only for use with the Slow Vehicle Turnout standard treatment (TES 10530). Left arrow 125 long (50/125/50), the AS 1743 open-chevron arrow in black.
